description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension. Date key: Decision Date (join qua Examination Team)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN violation_record ON violation_record.violation_record_id = violation_record_behavior.violation_record_id AND violation_record.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD' AND violation_record.examination_team_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = violation_record.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' → LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = examination_team.decision_dt AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date
